remarks: Welcome to your new home in the heart of Riverside, CT! This charming 1,100 sq. ft. unit offers comfortable and stylish living in a vibrant community. It features two well-sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with its own private bathroom. The modern kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, elegant marble countertops, and beautiful cabinetry. The open-concept living and dining area provides a bright and airy space, perfect for entertaining. Enjoy the outdoors on your private deck, ideal for relaxing or dining al fresco. With ample storage provided by a full attic and a large laundry room, you'll have plenty of space to keep everything organized. Additionally, this unit includes a 1-car garage for your convenience. The complex, with its 70 units, offers a range of amenities to enhance your lifestyle. The clubhouse serves as a central hub for community gatherings and events, while the pool allows you to cool off during the warm summer months. A variety of activities are available to keep you engaged and connected with your neighbors. Centrally located, this complex provides easy access to local shops, dining, and parks. Don't miss out on this wonderful rental opportunity in Riverside, CT!
